study.title: Towards automated weed detection through two-stage semantic segmentation of tobacco and weed pixels in aerial Imagery
study.short_title: Two-Stage Semantic Segmentation of Tobacco and Weed Pixels

models_tested: UNet (backbones: Vanilla Mini CNN, VGG16, MobileNet)
Proposed 2-stage: UNet+VanillaMini (stage I) then UNet+VGG16 (stage II)
segmentation.best_model: Two-stage UNet: Stage-I UNet/Vanilla-Mini-CNN (background vs vegetation) + Stage-II UNet/VGG16 (background, tobacco, weed)

dataset.name: New tobacco-weed aerial dataset (8 fields, Mardan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan, 2021)
dataset.note: DJI Mavic Mini drone at ~4 m AGL, GSD 0.1 cm/pixel; 1920x1080 images cropped to non-overlapping 480x352 patches (last 24 rows shared 80% with next frame); crop age 15-40 days; labels background/crop/weed = 0/1/2; training on one whole field, testing on seven others.

segmentation.backbone: Stage-I: Vanilla Mini CNN (UNet); Stage-II: VGG16 (UNet)

mIoU.quote: we achieved the maximum performance of MIOU = 0.91 using Vanilla Mini and VGG 16 as backbones of UNet in stage-I and II
mIoU.ambiguity: Best configuration (Stage-I Vanilla Mini/UNet + Stage-II VGG16/UNet): BG IoU 0.98, crop IoU 0.85, weed IoU 0.91, mIoU 0.91. Per-field mIoU ranges 0.78-0.92 across seven test fields (best field 0.92). One-stage baseline SegNet/VGG16 mIoU 0.78.

mPA.ambiguity: Pixel accuracy not reported; IoU/mIoU used.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Weed class IoU 0.91 (two-stage) vs 0.76 (one-stage) - reported as IoU not F1.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Tobacco crop IoU 0.85 (two-stage) vs 0.67 (one-stage) - reported as IoU not F1.

fps.ambiguity: Inference stated as 'below one second' per 480x352 image (Table 4); no FPS given.

latency_ms.quote: We have checked the inference time for one image of size 480 × 352; it is below one second
latency_ms.ambiguity: Reported only as 'below one second' (not exact) per 480x352 patch on desktop i5 + GTX 1050; 2-stage doubles inference vs 1-stage; offline suitability; Jetson Nano deployment planned as future work, not executed.

params_M.ambiguity: Stage-I (471,586) + Stage-II (12,321,603) = 12,793,189 trainable parameters for the 2-stage model (structural; not edge-deployed).

issues: Two-stage pipeline doubles inference time vs one-stage (below 1 s per patch on desktop; no on-board benchmark).
Slight discrepancy: best-config mIoU 0.91 (Table 3) vs best single field 0.92 (Table 2); per-field range 0.78-0.92.
No F1/pixel-accuracy reported; class-wise IoU used.
